label: SYNTHETIC DEMO rule set — invented for development, not NBB content
notes: All questions, controls, gates and levels in this file are invented examples.

triage_questions.help_text: How much would a failure of this system affect the organisation?
How valuable is the information or service to the business?

triage_questions.text: [Demo] Will the system store or process personal data?
triage_questions.help_text: Names, identity numbers, contact details or similar.

triage_questions.text: [Demo] Will the system be reachable from the internet?
[Demo] Is a third party hosting or operating the system?
triage_questions.help_text: SaaS, managed service or outsourced operation.

triage_questions.text: [Demo] Will it process payments or financial transactions?
[Demo] Will it integrate with other systems through APIs?
[Demo] Will privileged or administrative access be required?
[Demo] Will external customers use it directly?
[Demo] Does it involve new hardware or physical devices?

rules.reason: [Demo] High impact, high value and financial transactions.
[Demo] Personal data, financial transactions or high impact.
[Demo] Internet exposure, customer use or moderate/high value.

controls.title: Named system owner
controls.description: A named, accountable owner exists for the system.

controls.title: Role-based access control
controls.description: Access is granted by role and least privilege.

controls.title: Joiner / mover / leaver process
controls.description: Accounts are created, changed and removed through a defined process.

controls.title: Encryption of personal data at rest
Encryption in transit
controls.description: Network traffic carrying business data is encrypted.

controls.title: Personal data retention
controls.description: Retention periods are defined and enforced.

controls.title: Perimeter protection for internet-facing services
controls.description: Internet-facing services sit behind filtering and rate limiting.

controls.title: Authenticated API integration
controls.description: APIs authenticate callers and validate input.

controls.title: Log monitoring
controls.description: Security logs are reviewed or monitored.

controls.title: Vendor security assessment
controls.description: The vendor's security posture has been assessed.

controls.title: Contractual security clauses
controls.description: Contracts include security and breach-notification clauses.

controls.title: Patch management
controls.description: Security patches are applied within defined timelines.

controls.title: Backup and recovery
controls.description: Backups exist and restoration has been tested.

controls.title: Device hardening
controls.description: New devices are hardened before deployment.

controls.title: Transaction integrity controls
controls.description: Financial transactions are protected against tampering.

assessment_questions.text: [Demo] Has a named system owner been identified and agreed?
[Demo] Is access granted by role, following least privilege?
[Demo] Do privileged accounts require multi-factor authentication?
[Demo] Is there a defined joiner/mover/leaver process for accounts?
[Demo] Is personal data encrypted at rest?
[Demo] Is all network traffic encrypted in transit (e.g. TLS 1.2+)?
[Demo] Are retention periods for personal data defined and enforced?
[Demo] Is the internet-facing service protected by filtering and rate limiting?
[Demo] Do all APIs authenticate callers and validate input?
[Demo] Are security events logged and reviewed?
[Demo] Has the vendor completed a security assessment or provided an independent report?
[Demo] Does the contract include security and breach-notification clauses?
[Demo] Are security patches applied within defined timelines?
[Demo] Are backups taken and has a restore been tested?
[Demo] Will new devices be hardened to a documented baseline?
[Demo] Are financial transactions protected against tampering and replay?

compliance_guidance.text: [Demo] Provide evidence of implementation before go-live.
[Demo] A Required control that will not be met needs a Reviewer exception and, for residual exposure, Formal Business Risk Acceptance.
[Demo] Reviewer exception recorded. Residual exposure still requires a Business Owner decision.
[Demo] Implement where practical and record evidence.
[Demo] Record the reason; the Reviewer judges whether residual risk needs acceptance.
[Demo] Reviewer exception recorded for a Recommended control.
[Demo] Optional control not adopted; no further action normally required.
[Demo] Exceptions are not normally needed for Optional controls.
